headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Public Trend Signals
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis and security checks to improve ClearInstall's risk assessment capabilities, ensuring safer local-first installations. Leverage machine learning for predictive insights on potential issues before installation.
actions: Implement a real-time dependency analysis feature using signals from Minireel/HGhub to detect and warn about known vulnerabilities or outdated dependencies.
Integrate machine learning models based on datasets from janestreet/agent_skills to predict and flag potential security risks, especially related to binding.gyp
Use data from huamidev/GestaltX for dynamic risk assessment, providing users with real-time updates on the safety of their package installations.
